ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues in Islam.
   B. Apply the teaching of Virtues in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Virtues in Islam has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Virtues in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06 ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06 .
   C. Say Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06  has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06  to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Tawbah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Tawbah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Tawbah has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawbah.
   D. Apply the teaching of Tawbah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith.
   B. Use Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Shariah religion intellect life property dignity? (1 mark)
   A. Say Shariah religion intellect life property dignity has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Shariah religion intellect life property dignity to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Shariah religion intellect life property dignity.
   D. Apply the teaching of Shariah religion intellect life property dignity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Use Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an.
   C. Say Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

10. Which response best shows understanding of Significance of Islamic Morality? (1 mark)
   A. Use Significance of Islamic Morality to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Significance of Islamic Morality has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Significance of Islamic Morality.
   D. Apply the teaching of Significance of Islamic Morality with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Qadar? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Qadar has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in Qadar with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Belief in Qadar to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Qadar.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Prohibitions in Islam Zina? (1 mark)
   A. Use Prohibitions in Islam Zina to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Prohibitions in Islam Zina has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Prohibitions in Islam Zina with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prohibitions in Islam Zina.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Contemporary Issues and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Islam in Kenya 07 7.2 Unity of Muslims 04 7.3 Muslim Institutions 09 Total Numbe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Islam in Kenya Eastern Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Unity of Muslims and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
